description: Ground truth for the iOS BuggyShop (ios/BuggyShop), like buggyshop/bugs.manifest.json. Each id matches a case in Bugs.swift. iOS reports name a screen, not a URL, and agents name screens loosely ("Cart", "Cart screen", "Desk Lamp detail"), so every page is "*" and the match patterns do the work.

bugs.summary: Setting an item's quantity to 0 with the stepper leaves it in the cart and the total unchanged.
Search is case-sensitive: 'mug' finds nothing, 'Mug' finds the Ceramic Mug.
Sorting by price compares prices as text: low to high gives $14, $39, $9.
Sign up accepts an invalid email such as 'not-an-email'.
Orders over $50 are still charged $5 shipping: the check uses the item count.
Applying any coupon, valid or not, does nothing and shows no message.
Opening the Reviews tab of a product with no reviews (Desk Lamp) crashes the app.
The add-to-cart buttons in the product list have no accessibility label.
